sources.title: Hindustan Times, the Election Commission's letter of 29 October 2026 putting back Tripura's revision
IANS in The Hans India, the Election Commission defers Tripura's revision again
News On AIR, the Election Commission's revised schedule for Tripura, quoting the Additional Chief Electoral Officer

notes: The dates come from the Election Commission's letter of 29 October 2026 as Hindustan Times reported it. The Commission's own letter was not found.

The revision has been put back twice. It was first rescheduled for the Village Committee elections of 28 September 2026 in the tribal areas, when house visits had been due to start on 5 September 2026. On 29 October 2026 the Commission put it back again, at the Chief Electoral Officer's request, because elections to 21 urban local bodies are due in the state.

Under the schedule of 29 October, booth level officers visit homes from 26 December 2026 to 25 January 2027. Claims and objections run to 2 March 2027, and notices and claims are to be decided by 1 April 2027.
The draft roll is due on 1 February 2027 and the final roll on 7 April 2027. These are scheduled dates and neither roll has been published.
An official quoted by IANS gives the qualifying date as 1 January 2027, and Hindustan Times says it had been 1 October 2026.
No roll has been frozen for the revision, nobody has been left off a draft and no notices have been sent.
cannot_show: There are no figures yet. The roll before the revision, the names left off and their reasons will be known only when the draft is published.
